guidance.heading: 2026 Outlook
section: The Company has revised its 2026 outlook to reflect year-to-date results and the anticipated impact of geopolitical uncertainty and interest rate volatility for the remainder of the year. The outlook drivers by segment are described in the accompanying earnings call presentation.

Measure | Actual 2025 | Prior | Revised
Revenue growth | 15 | Mid teens growth | Low teens growth
Adjusted EBITDA growth | 14 | Mid teens growth | Low teens growth
Adjusted EPS growth | 14 | Mid teens growth | Low teens growth

The financial outlook is based on the Company’s best available information as of the date of this press release, and remains subject to change based on numerous macroeconomic, geopolitical, international trade, health, social and related factors. The outlook does not include any further acquisitions.
